svg.title: Rishikesh S: a request traced through the stack, 212 ms
svg.desc: Rishikesh S. Full-stack engineer. TypeScript, fast backends, practical AI workflows. A trace of one request through edge (Vercel, AWS), route (Hono, Express, FastAPI), auth (Clerk, Better Auth), cache (Redis), data (Postgres, Drizzle), agent (AI SDK, Mastra, RAG), render (React, Next.js). The first time it is a cache miss and takes 212 ms. The second time it is a cache hit and takes 44 ms.
svg.text: Full-stack engineer. TypeScript, fast backends, practical AI workflows.
The same request twice, through the stack I work in. Timings are illustrative.
